theme: Light mode primary. High contrast achromatic UI base with high-energy functional orange.

brand.name: Skill Flow
brand.tagline: Turn Your Skills Into Your Career.
brand.concept: Personal Career GPS for students. Premium startup-level SaaS. Clean, minimal, energetic. Avoids generic LinkedIn clones. Uses 'Achromatic Deep-Neutral UI' mixed with 'Tactical Orange' for kinetic triggers.

rules: BANNED: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, Space Grotesk for headings.
Use 'Outfit' for all H1-H4. Apply tracking-tight for sizes > 32px to look energetic.
Use 'DM Sans' for body and dashboard data (clean, legible).
Hierarchy gap rule: Jump no more than 2 tailwind steps between heading and subheading.

colors.implementation: Do not flood sections with orange. Use orange ONLY for primary CTAs, active states, icons, and progress bar fills.

visual_enhancers: Glassmorphism: Use for the floating AI assistant button and sticky header nav (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-b border-border/40). NEVER use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays.
Borders & Shadows: Dashboard cards should have 'bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-2xl shadow-sm'.
Hover states: Elevate interactive cards with '-translate-y-1 shadow-md transition-all duration-200'.
Avatar/Icon backgrounds: Use soft tinted orange (bg-orange-50 text-orange-600) instead of solid orange for secondary visual indicators.

components.sidebar: Desktop: Fixed left sidebar nav. Mobile: Converts to bottom navigation bar.
components.circular_progress: Dashboard centerpiece. Build an SVG circular progress indicator using stroke-dasharray and framer-motion to animate the #FF6B00 stroke.
components.kanban: Application Tracker: Light gray (#F3F4F6) column backgrounds, white draggable application cards.
components.floating_ai: Bottom right fixed button. Pulse animation on hover. #FF6B00 background, opens a chat interface.
components.buttons: Smooth rounded (rounded-xl) for primary CTAs. Include hover and focus states.
components.gamification: Lightweight professional gamification badges for 'Proof of Skills'.

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. 1-col mobile, 3-col or 4-col desktop. Use tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6) for data correlation.
grids_and_layouts.marketing_layout: Asymmetrical structure for the 'Skill-to-Career flow' section. Large typography. Generous whitespace (py-24).
grids_and_layouts.padding: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6) to prevent text collision.

motion_and_interactions.libraries: framer-motion for React micro-animations. react-fast-marquee if needed.
rules: Animate the Skill-to-Career flow on the landing page (staggered fade-ins).
Number counters for the Career Readiness %. (framer-motion useSpring/useTransform).
Micro-animations on card hovers (scale 1.02 or slight translation).
No universal 'transition: all'. Explicitly state transition properties.

accessibility.contrast: Text must pass WCAG AA against its background. Do not place white text on light orange.
accessibility.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button').
accessibility.focus: Focus states must have high contrast (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#FF6B00] focus:ring-offset-2).

media_and_icons.icons: lucide-react (Standard) or @phosphor-icons/react. Do NOT use emojis.
media_and_icons.images: Use realistic photos for student representations. Abstract orange flow for minimal branding.

image_urls.description: Student focused on laptop. Ideal for Landing Page hero or Onboarding wizard.
Abstract wavy orange geometry. Use sparingly as a texture/background mask for the AI Skill Gap analysis section or hero backdrop.
Virtual learning interaction. Good for 'Learning Resources' or 'Projects' section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Read this file fully before starting implementation.
Create Javascript (.js or .jsx) files ONLY, NOT Typescript (.tsx).
Initialize tailwind config CSS variables in index.css. Map --primary to 25 100% 50% (#FF6B00), --background to 210 20% 98% (#F8FAFC), --card to 0 0% 100%, and --foreground to 222 47% 11%.
DO NOT output raw App.css with `text-align: center;`. Remove default React boilerplate CSS.
Prioritize UI composition using Shadcn components but override their default borders (use border-gray-200) and border-radius (rounded-2xl for cards).
Use standard semantic HTML for the marketing landing page flow (YOUR SKILLS → TARGET CAREER → SKILL GAP...).
Implement the Dashboard with a Sidebar (desktop) and Bottom Navigation (mobile).
Build the circular progress component from scratch using SVG + framer-motion if Shadcn chart is too rigid.
Include `data-testid` on ALL buttons, inputs, links, forms, and actionable items.
Add general UI/UX rules: avoid AI slop, no generic centering, add layered depth.
Install the fonts using: yarn add @fontsource/outfit @fontsource/dm-sans and import them in index.js.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and soft ambient shadows.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💡) for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than typical templates (p-6, p-8) to prevent cramped designs.
